newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Russia oil exports via Ukraine 53.5 mln T in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Russia oil exports via Ukraine 53.5 mln T in 1996.

text.p: Ukraine's two oil pipelines transported 53.5 million tonnes of Russian oil for export in 1996 out of a total of 65.2 million tonnes of Russian crude carried, a senior energy official said on Friday.
A State Oil and Gas Committee official told Reuters that in 1995 total Russian oil transported across Ukraine was 65.9 million tonnes and total Russian oil for exports 50.3 million.
Most of the balance between total oil carried and oil carried for export went to Ukraine's six oil refineries.
The Druzhba pipeline carried 16.63 million tonnes of Russian oil to the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Hungary and former Yugoslavia in 1996 compared with 18.00 million tonnes in 1995.

The Prydniprovski Mahistralni Naftoprovody (PMN) pipeline network, which carries Russian oil to the Ukrainian Black Sea port of Odessa and the Russian port of Novorossiisk, moved 36.86 million tonnes in 1996 from 32.26 million tonnes in 1995.
Druzhba earned 149 million hryvnias (about $85 million) last year compared to about 140 million hryvnias in 1995 (about $81 million).
PMN's earnings stood at 181 million hryvnias in 1996 (about $103 million), but no 1995 comparison was available.
